title: Code search
line: Follow an imported symbol to the place it is defined.

beats.caption: You ask where the CLI gets its greeting helper.
Code search follows the import to its definition.
beats.label: pi-code-search

beats.caption: The result names the source file and line.

takeaway.title: Start at the definition
takeaway.line: Follow a symbol in context when names appear in several files.

title.text: When you open an unfamiliar project, a function name only gets you part of the way.

scene.text: The agent starts at the command line file and asks where the greet function comes from. Code search follows that import and returns the source location.

takeaway.text: Ask from the file you’re reading when several places use the same name. That anchors the lookup to the call you care about.
